title: Payment Methods Overview
description: Overview of all available payment methods in Matjrii, including supported gateways and regional payment options.
content:
Payment Methods Overview

Matjrii supports 27+ payment gateways to accept payments from customers worldwide. Choose the payment methods that work best for your region and customer base.

Global Payment Gateways

These gateways work worldwide:

  • Stripe: Credit cards, digital wallets
  • PayPal: PayPal balance, credit cards
  • Bank Transfer: Direct bank transfers
  • Cryptocurrency: Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies via CoinGate

Regional Payment Gateways

Asia Pacific

  • Razorpay: India
  • Paystack: Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa
  • Flutterwave: Africa
  • PayTabs: Middle East
  • Skrill: Global digital wallet
  • Mollie: Europe
  • ToyyibPay: Malaysia
  • Iyzipay: Turkey
  • Khalti: Nepal
  • PayHere: Sri Lanka
  • CinetPay: Francophone Africa
  • Paiement: Francophone Africa
  • Nepalste: Nepal
  • Aamarpay: Bangladesh
  • Midtrans: Indonesia
  • Cashfree: India
  • SSPay: Myanmar
  • Xendit: Philippines, Indonesia

Latin America

  • MercadoPago: Latin America
  • Ozow: South Africa

Europe

  • Mollie: Netherlands, Belgium, Germany
  • YooKassa: Russia
  • Benefit: Bahrain
  • Easebuzz: India
  • FedaPay: Togo, Benin
  • PayTR: Turkey
  • Tap: Middle East

United States

  • Authorize.Net: USA
  • PaymentWall: Global

Payment Method Types

Credit/Debit Cards

Accept major credit and debit cards:

  • Visa
  • Mastercard
  • American Express
  • Discover
  • Regional cards

Digital Wallets

Accept digital wallet payments:

  • PayPal
  • Apple Pay
  • Google Pay
  • Amazon Pay
  • Regional wallets

Bank Transfers

Accept direct bank transfers:

  • ACH (US)
  • SEPA (Europe)
  • Local bank transfers
  • Wire transfers

Buy Now, Pay Later

Some gateways support installment payments:

  • Split payments
  • Installment plans
  • Deferred payments

Cryptocurrency

Accept cryptocurrency payments via CoinGate:

  • Bitcoin
  • Ethereum
  • Litecoin
  • And more

Choosing Payment Methods

When selecting payment methods, consider:

  • Your target market
  • Regional preferences
  • Transaction fees
  • Payment processing time
  • Currency support
  • Setup complexity

Payment Processing Time

Different methods have different processing times:

  • Credit cards: Instant
  • Digital wallets: Instant
  • Bank transfers: 1-5 business days
  • Cryptocurrency: 10-60 minutes

Transaction Fees

Payment gateways charge different fees:

  • Percentage of transaction
  • Fixed fee per transaction
  • Monthly subscription
  • No fees (for some methods)

Best Practices

  • Offer multiple payment options
  • Support local payment methods
  • Test all payment methods
  • Monitor transaction fees
  • Enable popular methods in your region
  • Provide clear payment instructions

  • Payment Configuration
  • Checkout Process
